corrects_defect.v1_defect: v1 froze NEW selection {2300-2302} + evaluation {3300-3304} banks AND pinned addendum_landscape.json as the oracle; the C2 run then drew teacher labels from the UNPINNED committed addendum_sweep_results.npz (OLD selection bank ~2100-2102) and never executed the new sel/eval sweeps -> internally inconsistent; the pre-registered outcome was reported NOT_ESTABLISHED (as-run descriptive only).
corrects_defect.v2_fix: v2 is internally consistent: the measured ORACLE and the TEACHER labels are BOTH built from the FROZEN new selection {2300-2302} + evaluation {3300-3304} banks, executed as a v2 sel/eval sweep in THIS phase; addendum_landscape is NOT reused. k-axis, S schedule, estimator, splits, 17-cell grid, and the history {2500,2501} + training {3500,3510,3520} banks are IDENTICAL to v1 (owner ruling: keep everything else fixed).
corrects_defect.owner_ruling: Item 1b authorized: fresh consistent v2 freeze then execute the frozen banks exactly; a clean v2 curve graduates the headline metric to pre-registered; the as-run v1 curve stays as the descriptive first look.
corrects_defect.anti_tuning: No anti-tuning violation occurred in v1 (numbers were real + red-team-reproduced); this is a protocol-fidelity upgrade, not a retune.

naming_A22: interaction-COUNT adaptation curve (k grasps); DISTINCT from the within-interaction frame-truncation axis (that figure is the history-variant comparison). Never conflate the two.
k0_is_blind: k=0 = the property-blind prior (flat); teacher = privileged k-INDEPENDENT flat ceiling.

acquisition_rule.honesty_class: information-sufficiency vs k (NOT the deployment protocol)
acquisition_rule.algorithm: step j (=k) uses cell(j)=(7*j) mod n_cells, template(j)=j mod 4, ell(j)=0.12+ell_step*cell(j); stride 7 is coprime to 17 and 25 so the first n_cells steps are a full permutation of the grid.
acquisition_rule.source: plan (frozen enumeration; regeneratable + byte-matched in C0)

estimator.spec: the student MEAN-POOLS the first k interactions' committed 42-D addendum features into a fixed order-invariant 42-D summary fed to the frozen head MLP[32,32]; k=0 bypasses the pooled summary -> property-blind prior head (identical to blind).
estimator.features: proprio(8) + pooled_temporal_shape(112->32) + action(2)  [addendum_manifest.json:features; sim/history.py:temporal_shape/drive_summary; A-17 action metadata]
estimator.head: MLP[32,32]  [addendum_manifest.json:critic_head]
estimator.training: per k: fit on TRAIN-setting k-prefixes across training seeds, model-select on VAL, evaluate on held-out TEST; leak-free (TEST never in any fit/scaler/CV). Deterministic training seeds frozen.

split_leak_free.note: ratio pairs R0/R1/R2 in TEST as A-15 invariance controls.

primary_task.name: lift_and_clear
primary_task.selection_regret_degenerate: lift argmax is material-INDEPENDENT (STATUS.md 2026-08-17 fast-loop Step 2/4) -> lift selection regret is DEGENERATE; reported honestly; discrimination is on the distal SECONDARY.

secondary_task.name: distal_spanning
secondary_task.note: a DISTINCT estimand; selection regret DISCRIMINATES here. Lift-grid endpoints are NON-COMPARABLE to distal-grid endpoints.

baselines.sysID_per_k: ridge over the k-prefix pooled shape features, refit leak-free at each k

metrics.map_rmse: sqrt(mean over grasp cells of (pred-measured)^2), averaged over unique-(B,w) TEST groups
metrics.tau_boundary_error: |cell(pred tau=0.5 crossing) - cell(measured crossing)| in grid cells (linear interp) + band IoU secondary
metrics.selection_regret: J(oracle argmax) - J(student argmax) scored on the oracle curve, over unique-(B,w) TEST groups
metrics.aggregation_A15: unique-(B,w)-group level mean + std (not per-rollout); ratio pairs are invariance controls

reference_endpoints_DESCRIPTIVE.note: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY -- never a gate; NON-COMPARABLE across the lift(17-cell/0.03) and distal(25-cell/0.02) grids. A flat or non-monotone curve is a valid honest outcome.

oracle_source.built_from: the FROZEN evaluation bank {3300,3301,3302,3303,3304} run over the 17-cell lift grid in THIS phase (winner-template selected from the selection-bank success)
oracle_source.scoring: lift-and-clear: delta = clamp_z - tip_z; success = delta<=h (h=0.009); the evaluation-bank mean success per (setting, cell) = the oracle success_rate
oracle_source.NOT_reused: addendum_landscape.json (the v1 pinned oracle) is NOT used

teacher_label_source.seeds: {2300,2301,2302} (the FROZEN new selection bank), run over the 17-cell lift grid in THIS phase
teacher_label_source.note: teacher critic + student distillation targets are trained on the winner-template selection-bank labels from THESE draws

history_reuse.note: the student k-prefix histories are REUSED unchanged -- the frozen history bank {2500,2501} + schedule are IDENTICAL to v1, so no re-extraction; content-bound by digest above

discipline.A16: multiple training seeds + seed variability; eval-draw bootstrap LABELED conditional on the trained models
discipline.A17: explicit grasp/length action metadata in the features

acceptance: PROTOCOL + HONESTY, NOT performance: the FROZEN protocol executed EXACTLY, INCLUDING the new selection {2300-2302} + evaluation {3300-3304} banks actually RUN this phase to build BOTH the teacher labels AND the oracle (verified: those exact seeds present in the v2 sweep artifacts); enumerated S; mean-pool estimator; leak-free split; 17-cell lift grid; history {2500,2501} + training {3500,3510,3520} identical to v1. Then the honest per-k curve with seed bands + ORDERING (blind=k0, teacher=flat ceiling, sysID-per-k shown) + band IoU + ratio invariance + A-22 naming. Reference endpoints + monotonicity are DESCRIPTIVE only. A clean pass GRADUATES the headline metric to pre-registered.

outcome_binding_rule.rule: every frozen eligible cell is outcome-binding; a post-C1 divergence/non-convergence/out-of-guard -> that cell INCONCLUSIVE + STOP; NEVER thinned to a salvaged result; NO retuning.
outcome_binding_rule.reference_endpoints_never_gate: approach-to-reference and monotone-within-seed-noise are DESCRIPTIVE reporting only.

provenance.note: c1 = this single-file v2 freeze; the C2-v2 sweep commit MUST be a git descendant (git merge-base --is-ancestor c1 c2).
